d.ko: A spooky, freeware RPG where you search the afterlife for your brother. Reap ghosts with your scythe, explore haunted caves, and eat ghostly treats on your journey through death.
d.en: A spooky, freeware RPG where you search the afterlife for your brother. Reap ghosts with your scythe, explore haunted caves, and eat ghostly treats on your journey through death.
d.zh: 这是个飘着鬼魂的免费RPG游戏，你要在这个死后世界寻找你的弟弟。在穿越死亡的旅程中，用镰刀收割幽灵，探索闹鬼的山洞，还有鬼魅的美食可供享用。
